sentences.text:
?Neutral Citation No. - 2024:Ahc:172900
Court No. - 66
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 36517 of 2024

Applicant :- Usha Devi
Opposite Party :- State of U.P.

Counsel for Applicant :- Satish Kumar Yadav
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Sameer Jain,J.
1.

Heard Sri Satish Kumar Yadav, learned counsel for the applicant and Sri Manav Chaurasiya,
learned Aga for the State.

2. The instant bail application has been filed seeking release of the applicant on bail in Case Crime
No.163 of 2024, under Sections 498A, 304B Ipc and Section 3/4 D.P. Act, Police Station Kurra,
District Mainpuri, during pendency of the trial.

3.  Learned counsel for the applicant submits that applicant is mother-in-law of the deceased and on the basis of false allegation of demand of dowry and torture, she has been made accused along with her other family members including husband of the deceased.
4.

He further submits that actually son of the applicant i.e. husband of the deceased was doing job of labourer in Delhi and deceased always insisted to live with him in Delhi but due to his financial condition, her husband was unable to live in Delhi along with his wife and only due to this reason,
deceased committed suicide by hanging herself.

He next submits that Postmortem Report of the Usha Devi vs State Of U.P. on 5 November, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/151193509/
1 deceased also suggests that she died due to hanging.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
5. He further submits that applicant is a lady and there is no specific allegation against her and she is not having any criminal history and in the present matter applicant is in jail since 15.06.2024 i.e.
for last more than four months.
6.

Per contra, learned AGA opposed the prayer for bail and submits that daughter-in-law of the applicant died within three years of her marriage under abnormal circumstances and there is also allegation of demand of dowry but could not dispute the fact that applicant is mother-in-law of the deceased and there is no specific allegation against her and deceased died due to hanging.
7. I have heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record of the case.

8. Considering the argument advanced by learned counsel for the applicant and the fact that applicant is mother-in-law of the deceased and there is no specific allegation against her and deceased died due to hanging and in the present matter, applicant is in jail since 15.06.2024 i.e. for last more than four months, in my view, applicant is entitled to be released on bail.
9. Accordingly, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, the instant bail application is allowed.

10. Let the applicant - Usha Devi be released on bail in the aforesaid case on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:-
(i) The applicant shall appear before the trial court on the dates fixed, unless his personal presence is exempted.
(ii) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly, make inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
(iii) The applicant shall not indulge in any criminal and anti-social activity.
11. In case of breach of any of the above condition, the prosecution will be at liberty to move an application before this Court for cancellation of the bail of the applicant.

12. It is clarified that the observations made herein are limited to the facts brought in by the parties pertaining to the disposal of bail application and the said observations shall have no bearing on the merits of the case during trial.
Order Date :- 5.11.2024 S.A.
